expires_today.title: Lost Lands Adventure for 5th Edition by Frog God Games
expires_today.description: Can you survive the Lost Lands?
expires_today.long_description: Can you survive the Lost Lands? Gather your friends and roll the dice, because it’s time to journey into the Lost Lands! We’ve teamed up with Frog God Games for this massive TTRPG bundle chock-full of resources to plan your next campaign. Explore the winding streets of Bard’s Gate, a citadel of artisans and politicians whose people are menaced by dark forces within and without. Use the Tome of Artifacts to scatter magical weapons and relics throughout the land for your players to find. Find a starting point for your adventure with expanded description manuals like Rappan Athuk: Adventures in Zelkor’s Ferry. You can even score a physical copy of The World of the Lost Lands, the definitive guide to the entire setting, full of information on its locations, peoples, and historical data! Endless adventure awaits you in this bundle of nearly 80 TTRPG ebooks, so grab it now at the price of your choice and support Doctors Without Borders with your purchase!
